contract: Small qualitative CD-45 subset rerun with standard rlms v0.1.3, standard/unlabeled context_window_text, Gemini 2.5 Flash via OpenRouter, and rlms trajectory logger. Use only for generated-program trace inspection, not as a benchmark row.
paper_framing: Closes the 'no CD-45 generated program text at all' trace gap for a small subset. It does not alter aggregate CD-45 accuracy claims and does not test official SRLM/lambda-RLM.
